title: swarmsim scenario expectations (v1)
description: What one swarm under test is expected to fail. A scenario file's own expect describes this repository's reference swarm; another swarm has other known limitations, and may have fixed the reference's. They are written down next to that swarm and passed to the runner (--expect, the action's expect input). With an expectations file the scenario files' own expect is ignored: a scenario named here must fail, every other scenario must pass.

expect_fail.description: Scenario name -> why this swarm is expected to fail it. A known limitation, written down: if the swarm starts passing the scenario, the runner reports xpass and fails the suite. A name that matches no scenario in the run is reported and ignored.
